facts.fact: Liberia's biometric national ID system, launched in 2012, runs on a platform the NIR still uses, though card issuance has been suspended since June 2025.
State-owned LIBTELCO already runs a Tier III facility where the ID system could be co-located, per LITCON testimony reported by FrontPage Africa.
